properties.headline: Tornado Warning issued September 30 at 4:06PM CDT until September 30 at 4:45PM CDT by NWS Wichita KS
properties.description:
TORICT

The National Weather Service in Wichita has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
West central Barton County in central Kansas...

* Until 445 PM CDT.

* At 406 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located 6 miles northeast of Ash Valley, moving northeast at 30
mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed.
Damage to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree
damage is likely.

* This dangerous storm will be near...
Albert around 415 PM CDT.
Olmitz around 430 PM CDT.
properties.instruction:
TAKE COVER NOW! Move to a basement or an interior room on the lowest
floor of a sturdy building. Avoid windows. If you are outdoors, in a
mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter
and protect yourself from flying debris.

CMAMtext: NWS: TORNADO WARNING in this area til 4:45 PM CDT. Take shelter now. Check media.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: TORNADO WARNING in this area until 4:45 PM CDT. Take shelter now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.

properties.headline: Tornado Warning issued September 30 at 4:35PM CDT until September 30 at 4:45PM CDT by NWS Wichita KS
properties.description:
At 435 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located over Olmitz, or near Otis, moving northeast at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree damage is
likely.

This tornadic thunderstorm will remain over mainly rural areas of
west central Barton County.
properties.instruction:
TAKE COVER NOW! Move to a basement or an interior room on the lowest
floor of a sturdy building. Avoid windows. If you are outdoors, in a
mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter
and protect yourself from flying debris.

If a tornado or other severe weather is spotted, report it to the
National Weather Service or your local nearest law enforcement agency
who will send your report. This act may save lives of others in the
path of dangerous weather.

NWSheadline: A TORNADO WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 445 PM CDT FOR WEST CENTRAL BARTON COUNTY

properties.headline: Tornado Warning issued September 30 at 4:39PM CDT until September 30 at 4:45PM CDT by NWS Wichita KS
properties.description:
The storm which prompted the warning has weakened below severe
limits, and no longer appears capable of producing a tornado.
Therefore, the warning will be allowed to expire.

A Tornado Watch remains in effect until 1100 PM CDT for central
Kansas.

To report severe weather, contact your nearest law enforcement
agency. They will relay your report to the National Weather Service
Wichita.

NWSheadline: THE TORNADO WARNING FOR WEST CENTRAL BARTON COUNTY WILL EXPIRE AT 445 PM CDT
